purpose: Induction workload. Running these on gpt-4o-mini produces the OUTPUTS that, after hand-labelling, become the bc-038 ground-truth corpus. These tasks are not themselves the corpus and no evaluator sees this file.

policies.refund: Refunds are issued within 18 days of delivery, exclusive of the delivery date.
policies.shipping: Standard shipping is 5 business days; expedited is 2.
policies.warranty: Hardware carries a 24-month limited warranty from the invoice date.
policies.restock: Items below their reorder point are restocked to twice the reorder point.

knowledge_base.kb-retention: Traces are retained for 30 days on the free tier and 90 days on team plans.
knowledge_base.kb-export: Data can be exported as JSONL through the export endpoint.
knowledge_base.kb-regions: The service runs in eu-central and us-east.
knowledge_base.kb-sso: SSO is available on enterprise plans via SAML.
knowledge_base.kb-ratelimit: The ingest endpoint accepts 500 spans per second per project.
knowledge_base.kb-sdk: Official SDKs exist for Python and TypeScript.
